name: 0-10V Ballast Dimmer
description: A controller for dimmable lighting ballasts that use a 0-10 VDC control input. It also has two relay outputs that can switch non-dimmable ballasts of up to 5 amps each.
notes: HouseLinc names it Insteon Ballast Dimmer.
Drives a 0-10 V output and two relayed loads; on cmd1 0x11 or 0x13, cmd2 0x01 selects load 1, 0x02 load 2 and 0x03 both.
